6101.Story: Tufty Ears are soft, white animals that cohabit with humans. They are gregarious and enjoy traveling together or lounging under the sun in groups of two or three. Legend has it that they were made out of the life essence of the Divine Light, so they are frequently seen in temples and other such places that are filled with the Divine Light's essence. They were named after their pair of long ears which are shaped like the ear of wheat.

6102.Story: Grassy Orbs are amazing creatures that enjoy hiding in shrubs or bushes. They move around by attaching themselves to animals or carriages. Often seen in the wild, they resemble large piles of grass that roll with the wind, hence their name.

6105.Story:
An avian creature from the Hunting Fields, the Flutterplume Owl has a pair of powerful wings that can sustain long flights. It is a superb scout that is highly sensitive to its surroundings and extremely territorial.
After sensing that its territory has been invaded, an incensed Flutterplume Owl will create a time zone over the battlefield, which alters the passage of time in the area and grants an advantage to its allies.
By nature, the Flutterplume Owl is nocturnal and hides away in the forest during the day. However, after being tamed and trained as a beast, it will adjust its circadian rhythm to adapt to its partner and assist them from the air in battle.
It is friendly and dependable to those it deems as a partner. It allows allies into its territory, and will even perch and rest on the shoulders of particularly-trusted friends. When a Flutterplume Owl is happy, it flaps its wings and hoots, which many consider to be a beautiful sound.

6106.Story:
The Bellbellow is a unique beast nurtured by endless force of life. They are so named because of their endearing sound that resembles that of a fawn calling in the midst of a forest. Distinct from other beasts skilled at slaughter, they have countless blessings coursing through their awakened veins. These holy blessings swirl around their antlers and grow into pristine white flowers.
Bellbellows can deliver blessings to allies in distress and cure them of their pain and bring them protection. Whenever they walk gently over a patch of arid land, they leave behind a trail of life and growth.
These wondrous beasts run freely with the wind across fields and forests, and will dash immediately to any ally in need on a battlefield.

6107.Story:
Fire Breathers are creatures that roam the volcanic zones, notable for their charred hair and often accompanied by sparks of flame.
They have a fiery temper and regard all living beings as enemies. That's why hardly any other creatures are seen around their territory, and taming them is an incredibly risky undertaking. However, if you manage to do so, the hard work will pay off as they will be loyal to you as their only companion and ally.

6108.Story:
Legend has it that Feline Vesperios are the symbol of death and destruction. Despite their small stature, they are formidable beasts with a pair of powerful skeletal wings. They are creatures of the dark, with their wings resembling broken skeletal fragments, while parts of their bodies burn in eerie flames due to their constant presence in the dark.
By howling, Feline Vesperio can summon powerful Darkfire Balls, which will reveal enemies as their true selves and subject them to overwhelming spiritual shock.
A Feline Vesperio is the shadow of hopelessness. It burns in flames of vengeance and has lost its pursuit for light. Filled with despair and resentment, the fiery beast yearns for the day it can pull all creatures of light into the dark abyss.

6109.Story:
The Ice Crown, a unique beast formed when water elements take humanoid shape, thrives in cold, watery environments. They lead a communal life, seeking companionship. However, isolated Ice Crowns cannot survive for long and revert to water elements.
Gentle and fond of singing, the Ice Crown summons ice and snow with its melodic voice. In danger, it freezes itself into dormancy, but if its companions are threatened, it breaks free to protect them. An angered Ice Crown is dangerous, releasing frost on perceived threats. Those accidentally frozen by it sleep forever in its ice coffin.
